item_short_desc: Rothco's Ammo Pouches offer durability and functionality for hunters, sport shooting pros, and other outdoor enthusiasts. Constructed with heavy-duty canvas, these 2-pocket pouches provide reliable storage for ammunition or other small essentials. Each ammunition pouch features a loop for easy attachment to your tactical belt, ensuring secure and convenient carry. Whether you're hunting, hiking, or engaging in other outdoor activities, these storage pouches keep your ammunition easily accessible and organized.
